ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has incorporated two new wholly-owned subsidiaries, Amshuman Renewables Private Limited and Urjita Powertech Private Limited, both established to develop and operate power generation and renewable energy projects. This represents a strategic intent to expand its renewable energy portfolio, with a nominal initial cash investment of Rs. 1,00,000 for each entity. There are no material financial impacts or red flags identified at this preliminary stage, as this is a standard corporate structural disclosure.
